title: Senior Associate, Security Development & Automation
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

The Senior Associate, Security Development & Automation is a hands-on technical contributor who helps protect Northern Trust by engineering automation-first security capabilities. This role supports the design and delivery of AI-enabled workflows, API integrations, playbooks, scripts and platform services that strengthen cyber defense, reduce manual operational burden and make security outcomes more consistent, measurable and repeatable. The Senior Associate works with security engineering, operations, infrastructure, application, risk, audit and technology teams to understand high-value security workflows, translate them into automation patterns and deliver solutions that improve control execution, threat response, vulnerability management, evidence collection and operational resilience.

**What You'll Do**

***Protect Northern Trust Through Security Driven Development and Automation***

* Build development and automation capabilities that help protect Northern Trust’s technology environment, reduce cyber risk and improve the consistency of security execution.
* Engineer AI agent-based workflows that support security triage, enrichment, correlation, investigation support, evidence collection, control validation and remediation orchestration.
* Create secure API integrations across security platforms, ITSM, CMDB, vulnerability management, cloud, network, identity, data and observability tools to connect signals, decisions and actions.
* Develop reliable workflow automation assets that remove friction from security operations and make high-value controls easier to operate at scale.
* Partner with security architecture, platform engineering, cloud security, IAM, threat and governance teams to apply reusable automation standards, secure engineering patterns, guardrails and operational handoffs.

***Key Deliverables***

* Develop and support security development and automation capabilities that help Northern Trust protect critical services and data, including:

– Security workflow automation that accelerates discovery, response, remediation and control validation

– API integrations and reusable playbooks that connect security platforms, enterprise data sources and operational systems of record

– AI-enabled assistants and agents that improve security decision support while respecting enterprise controls, approvals and data protection requirements

– Design and Build LLM-based vulnerability scanning and remediation solutions.

* Integrate LLM capabilities responsibly using enterprise AI platforms such as AI Foundry, approved model providers and vendor AI harnesses to enhance—not replace—security judgment and control execution.
* Develop prompt, retrieval, orchestration, testing and evaluation patterns that make AI-enabled workflows reliable, observable, secure and aligned to enterprise policy.
* Engineer automation with strong authentication, authorization, secrets handling, logging, exception handling, change control and auditability so solutions can be trusted in production security workflows.
* Document architecture, runbooks, decision logic, reusable patterns and operational handoffs so capabilities can be supported, governed and improved over time.
* Contribute to platform roadmaps, vendor integrations and automation priorities by providing practical engineering input tied to risk reduction, control effectiveness, resiliency, stability and reuse.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, software engineering, security automation, cloud engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure automation or related technology disciplines.
* Strong understanding of how development and automation can be used to protect enterprise environments, improve control execution and reduce operational risk.
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior technical contributor: supporting solution design, contributing to architecture discussions, delivering complex technical work and helping drive adoption through collaboration and practical execution.
* Hands-on development skills in Python, including API consumption, data transformation, automation frameworks, error handling, testing and operational supportability.
* Experience integrating security, ITSM, cloud, identity, observability or data platforms through REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven patterns, workflow tools or orchestration platforms.
* Working knowledge of LLM-enabled solution patterns, AI agent workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, model evaluation, AI guardrails and secure use of enterprise AI platforms.
* Ability to deliver in a regulated environment with strong attention to audit-ready evidence, access controls, change management, testability, resiliency and production support.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience in financial services, banking, asset servicing, wealth management or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience with ServiceNow workflows, Vulnerability Response, SecOps, CMDB, ITSM integrations or similar enterprise workflow platforms.
* Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, GitHub Actions, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines or cloud-native automation patterns.
* Experience building automation for vulnerability management, exposure management, threat response, identity security, network security or cloud security operations.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  

**About Our Pune Office**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

This role leads the active shift team, manages critical incident escalations (P1/P2), ensures strict adherence to ticket SLAs, and executes advanced network maintenance across global enterprise routers, switches, firewalls, and SD-WAN networks.

The NOC Shift Leader is responsible for the operations and maintenance of the Network consisting of a wide range of platforms, systems, applications and perform the following duties:

**Key Responsibilities**

**Shift Leadership & Operational Management**

 Lead and supervise assigned shift personnel (L1 monitoring engineers and service desk

analysts) to ensure smooth 24/7 NOC operations.

 Monitor real-time queue health, ticket distribution, and response/resolution SLAs across

all incoming network incidents and service requests.

 Oversee shift handover processes, ensuring pending outages, high-priority tickets, and

planned maintenance activities are seamlessly transferred without gaps.

 Mentor, train, and conduct knowledge-sharing sessions for L1 staff to improve first-

contact resolution rates and SOP quality.

 Monitor voice infrastructure health, trunk utilization, and voice traffic trends using

monitoring platforms.

**Advanced L2 Troubleshooting & Incident Management**

 Serve as the technical escalation point for L1 engineers on non-SOP, complex, or

degraded-performance network events.

 Handle escalated tickets from Tier 1 support regarding call quality, SIP registration

issues, trunk dropouts, IVR misrouting, and softphone errors.

 Identify and resolve Mean Opinion Score (MOS) degradation caused by jitter, packet

loss, or latency on voice VLANs.

 Diagnose and resolve complex routing, switching, security policy, and link connectivity

issues.

 Lead major incident bridges (P1/P2 outages), collaborating with L3 architecture teams,

vendor support engineering, and internal stakeholders to drive rapid MTTR (Mean Time

to Restore).

 Perform technical Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and generate Post-Incident Reports (PIR)

for major outages.

 Configure SBC firewall policies, access control lists (ACLs), and anti-toll fraud rules to

safeguard against unauthorized access and SIP scanning attacks.

**Network Maintenance & Change Execution**

 Configure and maintain IP PBX core features: dial plans, trunk routing, IVR menus, ring

groups, call queues, call recording, and voicemail-to-email routing.

 Provision and manage SIP trunks, ISDN PRIs, and FXS/FXO gateways across distributed

office locations.

 Review, approve, and execute low-to-medium risk Change Requests (CRs) during

maintenance windows (e.g., firmware upgrades, ACL updates, VLAN additions, device

reboots).

 Perform routine health audits, capacity checks, and configuration backups across

network infrastructure.

 Execute routine system maintenance, configuration backups, software updates, and

security patch management.

 Configure SBC firewall policies, access control lists (ACLs), and anti-toll fraud rules to

safeguard against unauthorized access and SIP scanning attacks.

 Coordinate with network engineering teams to verify Voice VLAN tagging (802.1Q) and

Quality of Service (QoS / DSCP EF 46) policies on switches and routers.

**The Work: Key Essentials**

 Day to day operations management and provide direct supervision

 Establish and maintain Service Level Agreements (SLA) with internal and external

customers and ensure the SLA standards are maintained.

 Weekly executive summary of the SLA measurement, program achievements and root

cause analysis when SLA targets are not achieved.

 Identifies faults, raise trouble tickets and provides resolution of complex problem

requests. Escalate from the previous tiers when necessary.

 Proficient in the technical administration, support of diverse and tightly integrated

systems including LINUX, Windows and modern monitoring applications.

 Act as the subject matter expert for the Client’s Network, Data services and to help

troubleshoot specific capacity and performance issues.

 Develop and maintain capacity and performance metrics to track overall server and

storage infrastructure trends.

 Supervise the daily work of all database, applications, and server administration staff to

ensure optimum performance.

 Enforce, maintain, and document compliance, maximum uptime and performance with

all established standards for the data center systems, including storage, LAN/WAN, and

server systems.

 Continually focus efforts on automation of the Network Operation Centre.

 Participate in the construction and reporting of relevant Network Operation Metrics to

senior management.

 Assist in developing policies and procedures to meet service expectations and quality for

network operations.

 Ensure that periodic checks of systems not under direct monitoring occurs. This includes

the checking of event logs, services, and actually launching the console

**Vendor & Telecom Management**

 Escalate complex circuit/hardware failures to major carriers and hardware OEMs **(Cisco**

**TAC, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Juniper).**

hardware RMA turnaround.

Etisalat, AT&T, Vodafone) for circuit outages or carrier-side SIP errors.

mortems in the Knowledge Base.

**Required Qualifications & Experience:**

**Education:** B.E. /B.Tech/ BCA, or MCA degree from a recognized institution.

**Experience:** 5 to 6 years of hands-on experience in Network Operations, with at least 2

years in an L2 technical capacity or senior shift coordination role.

**Certifications (Mandatory / Highly Preferred):**

**Security) — Mandatory or near completion.**

o **ITIL v4 Foundation** — Preferred.

are strong advantages.

**Technical Skills & Competencies**

 **Routing & Switching:** In-depth knowledge of BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS, VxLAN, Spanning

Tree Protocol (STP), HSRP/VRRP, and VXLAN.

 **Firewalls & Security:** Working knowledge of Fortinet, Palo Alto, Cisco ASA/FTD, and

Checkpoint firewalls (NAT rules, IPsec/SSL VPN tunnels, security policies).

 **Wireless &** SD-WAN: Experience managing enterprise wireless controllers (Cisco

Catalyst Center/DNA Center, Aruba) and SD-WAN solutions (Cisco Viptela, Fortinet SD-

WAN, Silver Peak).

 **Monitoring &** ITSM Platforms: Advanced usage of ServiceNow, Remedy, SolarWinds,

PRTG, Zabbix, or Splunk.

 **Protocols:** Strong command of SIP, RTP/RTCP, SDP, H.323, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and

technical executive summaries, conducting client calls, and leading shift bridge

meetings.

** Compensation Package:** Competitive Fixed Salary + Shift Leadership Allowance + Any

Our mission is to deliver secure, resilient, and high\-performance datacenter and cloud solutions for global operations.


Organized into four teams, Global Systems Engineering, Unix Engineering, Windows Engineering, and Database Engineering, this group drives operational excellence, security, high availability, compliance, and continuous improvement across our technology estate.


By championing automation, standardization, and proactive monitoring, and by working closely with application, security, and business teams, we ensure our environments are robust, stable, and scalable. Through this collaborative approach and a relentless focus on modernization, Jefferies’ infrastructure remains agile and adaptable, ready to meet the evolving needs of our global business.


**Job Summary**

Jefferies is seeking a dynamic, hands\-on, and strategic Senior Vice President (SVP), Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (Pune). This executive technical leader will lead automation, operations, and modernization of Jefferies’ platform stack, with a focus on critical platform domains: databases, virtualization, storage, backup, compute, and Unix/Windows server infrastructure. Based in Pune, India, the SVP will lead the Pune CIP team and be accountable for technical excellence, operational resilience, and end\-to\-end Pune led delivery supporting the US, EMEA and APAC estate. This role reports to the Head of GCC, Pune (primary) and the Global Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms, Jersey City (secondary).


This is not a pure management or “middle\-layer” role. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on domain expert who remains technically current, acts as a trusted escalation point and decision\-maker, and independently resolves complex infrastructure and operational challenges rather than simply escalating them.


Success in this role comes from earning the trust of engineers and global business stakeholders through demonstrated technical mastery, incident command, and the delivery of solutions that enable strategic business outcomes. The position requires deep technical expertise paired with proven people leadership to build, mentor, and scale high\-performing teams supporting 24/7 capital markets operations.  



**Key Responsibilities**

* **Global Platform Leadership:** partner with global leads on the vision, engineering standards, and operational governance for Jefferies’ core infrastructure stack: database, virtualization, storage, backup, compute, Unix/Linux, and Windows server platforms, across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.

* **Modernization \& Cloud/Hybrid Adoption:** Drive modernization, cloud/hybrid adoption, automation\-first delivery, and standardization across all domains, balancing operational excellence with innovation and optimization. Lead strategic integration and optimal workload placement between on\-premises and cloud resources, as business and regulatory requirements permit.
* **Hands\-on Technical Escalation:** Serve as the final point of escalation and technical incident lead during major outages, performance, or security incidents. Analyze real\-time symptoms, ask the right diagnostic questions, and guide teams towards root\-cause resolution.

* **Global Team Development:** Partner with global leads in NYC, London, and HK to cultivate a high\-performing, distributed team of engineers and architects, primarily based in India. You will mentor leaders and engineers, promote end\-to\-end ownership, and develop problem\-solving capability.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** Partner with business units, application teams, and senior platform leaders to align technical priorities, communicate platform direction, and enable local\-global business outcomes.
* **Technical Standards \& Documentation:** Author, maintain, and enforce robust operational standards, SLAs, playbooks, and knowledge base for platform operations and incident response.
* **Post\-Incident Review \& Learning:** Lead technical post\-mortems and deep\-dives, drive remediation, and foster a culture of continuous technical learning.
* **Regulatory \& Risk Alignment:** Execute robust security, compliance, vulnerability management, and audit readiness for mission\-critical infrastructure in a highly regulated financial services environment.

**Mandatory Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Experience:**
	+ 15\+ years in IT infrastructure/platform engineering and operations, with at least 5 years in global technical leadership (financial services or complex enterprise IT preferred).
	+ Proven recent, hands\-on experience with at least three of: database platforms (SQL/Oracle/etc), virtualization (VMware/Hyper\-V/KVM, Nutanix), storage (SAN/NAS), backup/DR, Unix/Linux, and Windows server engineering and operations.
	+ Track record as a solution owner, not just a conduit, able to independently architect and deliver technical outcomes in critical environments.
* **Core Competencies:**
	+ Deep technical expertise, able to lead troubleshooting, ask the right questions, synthesize technical indicators, and command resolution during platform issues and outages.
	+ Domain credibility, regarded by engineers and senior IT partners as the go\-to technical escalation contact.
	+ Record of driving platform modernization, cloud/hybrid/cloud adoption, automation, and cost/risk optimization.
	+ Strong foundation in regulatory, compliance, and operational risk management for infrastructure.
	+ Executive presence, able to command trust in both technical and business forums, and partner with C\-levels, application owners, and metro engineering leaders.
	+ Outstanding stakeholder management, communication, prioritization, and conflict resolution skills, on both local (India) and global scales.
	+ Experience designing and enforcing technical standards, SLAs, and incident management frameworks.
* **Certifications (optional, but valued):**Recognized certifications (RHCE, MCSE, VMware, Nutanix, NetApp, AWS/Azure/GCP, ITIL, etc.)  

	+

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent required; Master’s degree preferred.  

* 

**What Success Looks Like**

The SVP delivers a world\-class platform that serves as a resilient, secure, continuously modernizing backbone for all Jefferies business applications, across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. You lead actively, commanding incidents, delivering solutions, and growing your team’s technical and operational capability. You are trusted by engineers as a technical authority, by CIO/BU leaders as a business partner, and by the enterprise as the leader who enables robust, scalable solutions tightly aligned with the business's needs.
